title: Zoni's Void Dimension
description: Adds a Void Dimension to Minecraft
body:
[![alt text](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/aa8962f9-e6ff-4a83-8eeb-d145d3c55343.webp) ](https://bisecthosting.com/Zoni25)

This mod let's you make a Void Dimension by making a Portal, similar to the Nether Portal, but made with Block of Quartz and lighting it up with a Flint and Quartz, which crafting is with one Iron Ingot and one Nether Quartz.

 

If you want to get updates on the mod development, report bugs or suggest new stuff or just contact me join my discord server:
https://discord.com/invite/KWGakdBVwG
